dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, what are these green herbs?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ˈwʌt ər ðiːz ˈɡriːn ˈɜːrbz?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: This is basil. We use a lot of herbs in Thai food.
dialogue.reading: ˈðɪs ɪz ˈbeɪzəl. wiː ˈjuːz ə ˈlɑːt əv ˈɜːrbz ɪn ˈtaɪ ˈfuːd.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: And how much fish sauce do we need?
dialogue.reading: ənd ˈhaʊ ˈmʌtʃ ˈfɪʃ ˌsɔːs duː wiː ˈniːd?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Only a little. Fish sauce is very salty.
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊnli ə ˈlɪtəl. ˈfɪʃ ˌsɔːs ɪz ˈvɛri ˈsɔːlti.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: OK. And how much coconut milk?
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. ənd ˈhaʊ ˈmʌtʃ ˌkoʊkənʌt ˈmɪlk?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: A lot! Two cans. And a few chilies, too.
dialogue.reading: ə ˈlɑːt! ˈtuː ˈkænz. ənd ə ˈfjuː ˈtʃɪliz, ˈtuː.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Only a few? But I love spicy food!
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊnli ə ˈfjuː? bʌt aɪ ˈlʌv ˈspaɪsi ˈfuːd!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: OK, then let's use a lot of chilies!
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ, ˈðɛn ˈlɛts ˈjuːz ə ˈlɑːt əv ˈtʃɪliz!
